title: Hotel Front Desk Scam
scenario: A late-night caller says they are the front desk and need your card details again.

answers.A: Read the card number and security code over the phone.
answers.B: Give only the cardholder name so they can find the booking.
answers.C: Hang up and call reception using the hotel directory.
answers.D: Walk to reception and resolve the request in person.

explanation: Late-night timing lowers your guard. The front desk can verify a payment issue without collecting card details from an unexpected call.
proTip: Never let a room call become a card-security conversation.
